name: m4-max-120hz-input-to-frame
reference: Apple M4 Max, 120 Hz reference display
observed_basis: Four post-transport-repair runs on the M4 Max reference machine, 30 samples each: input-to-frame p50 15.81/15.83/15.81/15.89 ms, p95 20.88-23.96 ms, p99 23.96-25.27 ms. The budget keeps roughly 25-40 percent headroom over those runs.
measured_in: build/desktop/apps/desktop/lapis_terminal_latency_probe --samples 30 --output <receipt.json>; checked with python3 scripts/lapis.py performance-check <receipt.json> or just latency-budget

history.change: Tightened after the transport repair: whole-screen socket buffers cut the snapshot stage from about 24.7 ms to about 1.7 ms and input-to-frame p50 from 32.2 ms to 15.8 ms.
